nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.description: Sends the selected shopper action to the cart service and presents the resulting cart.

nodes.label: Cart service
nodes.description: Handles the action’s API call. Reads return the saved cart; writes update its lines or address and save tax state before responding.

nodes.label: cart, cart_line
nodes.description: Stores the cart and its line-level tax snapshot. Reads return that snapshot; writes save it after the tax decision or quote completes.

nodes.label: Region complete?
nodes.description: Choose whether the cart can request a destination-based tax quote.

logic.explanation: Check for a country plus any subdivision or postal code required for that destination. This condition represents validation, not just a non-empty country field.

branches.when: Yes · required region details are present
branches.then: Request a tax quote for the cart lines and delivery region.

branches.when: No · required region details are missing
branches.then: Keep line tax null and show “calculated at checkout”.

nodes.label: Set tax pending
nodes.description: Sets line tax, rate and rule ID to null and taxStatus to pending, then saves the cart. The storefront displays “calculated at checkout”.

nodes.label: Quote tax
nodes.description: Checks cached rates for the merchant, region and categories. On a miss, evaluates the current rules and caches the rates. Returns tax amounts and rule IDs to the cart service; it does not write the cart database.

nodes.label: Rate cache
nodes.description: Caches rates and rule IDs by merchant, region and category, with expiry at the next rule effective time. A hit returns these to Quote tax; a miss triggers rule evaluation. Rule-published events invalidate affected entries. The cache record schema is not documented yet.

nodes.label: Evaluate rules
nodes.description: On a cache miss, reads the effective rules for this merchant, region and product category. Returns matching rates and rule IDs to Quote tax.

nodes.label: tax_rules
nodes.description: Reads the rule versions effective at quote time. Publishing appends a new version; old versions remain available for order audits.

nodes.label: Rules console
nodes.description: Lets finance edit and publish versioned tax rules.

nodes.label: Publish rule
nodes.description: Validates the rule and saves a new version. Only after the save succeeds, emits the rule-published event and confirms publication to the console.

nodes.label: Invalidate cache
nodes.description: Invalidates cached rates affected by the published rule.
